rationale.edition: All 38 changed paths are OSS-owned. The frontend changes live under web/src/** (views/synthetics, components/synthetics, composables/useSyntheticsRecorder.ts, utils/synthetics, constants/synthetics, types/synthetics), the backend change is src/config/src/meta/synthetics.rs (OSS config meta), and the rest are scripts/translations + web/src/locales i18n. No path under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/, or any o2_* enterprise-owned directory changed (the enterprise synthetics backend o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/synthetics is untouched). No enterprise keyword (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appears in the changed paths or symbols. Edition = oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out (empty trigger_comment.txt, empty feature_hint.txt, and no tests-added/skip label passed in context). The change alters user-facing UI (CreateBrowserTest.vue and the journey step editor), so it is not docs-only, CI-only, or comment/test-data-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: this changes the Synthetics browser-test journey recorder UI. It adds click-type selection (left/right/middle button plus double-click via click_count), hover support in the v2 step vocabulary, 'record before step' and 'record before failed step' capabilities, and extension-version handshake/outdated detection — all user-exercisable interactions in the CreateBrowserTest journey editor that need verifying.
rationale.area: The bulk of the changes live under web/src/views/synthetics/, web/src/components/synthetics/, web/src/composables/useSyntheticsRecorder.ts, and web/src/utils/synthetics/. The matching Playwright area folder is Synthetics, where sibling browser-test specs would live.
rationale.group: No existing testfolder covers Synthetics in the checked-out ci-matrix manifests (ci_matrix.ent.json/cloud/env/firefox/scheduled list Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards/Alerts/Pipelines/Streams/Reports/GeneralTests/SDR/Correlation/Workflows/etc., but none named Synthetics). Set to a new 'Synthetics' shard; the Engineer must create it (or extend the OSS base ci_matrix.json if a Synthetics shard already exists there).
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed *.spec.ts files under web/src/** are Vitest unit tests (component/composable/util), not tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js — they are not E2E coverage and do not set existing_tests_in_diff.
